name: matter
description: Matter — Ultra-Minimalist Multi-Terminal Agent Platform & Inter-Agent Coordination Desktop App

scripts.dev: concurrently -k "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.desktop:dev: concurrently -k "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev" "electron ."
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build && node electron/generate-icons.cjs && electron-builder --dir
scripts.package:win: npm run build && node electron/generate-icons.cjs && electron-builder --win
scripts.package:mac: npm run build && node electron/generate-icons.cjs && electron-builder --mac
scripts.package:linux: npm run build && node electron/generate-icons.cjs && electron-builder --linux
scripts.package:all: npm run build && node electron/generate-icons.cjs && electron-builder -mwl
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install

author: Google DeepMind Pair Programming
